start: Enquiries screen, one enquiry with a call-back day of today and a phone number

steps.action: Open Enquiries
user_sees: Title 'Enquiries', under it 'People who asked about joining'
Chips labelled 'Show enquiries', each with a count
The row shows the name, the number, a 'Today' pill and 'Call back <day> · <how far>'
Buttons 'Call', 'WhatsApp', 'Add as member', 'Follow-up date', 'Not interested'
must_not: A count on a chip that differs from the rows shown under it
An enquiry due today missing from the first list

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab with a ready follow-up message that names the gym
The Enquiries screen is still open behind it
must_not: The message sent by itself without the person pressing send in WhatsApp
Another person's number in the WhatsApp address

steps.action: Back in the panel tap 'Follow-up date'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Call <name> again'
Line 'Pick a day. One tap saves it.'
Quick day buttons, 'Or pick a date', buttons 'Cancel' and 'Save date'
must_not: A day in the past offered as a quick pick

steps.action: Tap one quick day
user_sees: The sheet closes
The row leaves the call-today list and shows the new call-back day under the later list
must_not: The old call-back day still shown after a refresh
Two rows for the same person

start: Enquiries screen, an open enquiry; the other ways: Call, and a hand-picked date

steps.action: Tap 'Call'
user_sees: The phone's dialler opens with the person's number, with the country code
must_not: A number without the country code, or a different number from the one on the row

steps.action: Tap 'Follow-up date', pick a day in 'Or pick a date', tap 'Save date'
user_sees: Under the date box a line saying how far the day is
The sheet closes and the row shows the new day
must_not: The date saved a day early or late
The sheet closing when the save failed

start: Enquiries screen, an open enquiry; and one enquiry that came from a web chat with no number

steps.action: Tap 'Follow-up date', leave the date box empty, tap 'Save date'
user_sees: Under the box: 'Pick a date.'
The sheet stays open
must_not: The call-back day wiped
The sheet closing as if saved

steps.action: Type a day before today, tap 'Save date'
user_sees: Under the box: 'The follow-up date can’t be in the past.'
must_not: A past day saved

steps.action: Look at the enquiry that left no number
user_sees: 'No number left yet' in place of the number
No 'Call' and no 'WhatsApp' button on that row
must_not: A Call or WhatsApp button that opens with an empty number

steps.action: With the internet off, look at the buttons that save
user_sees: 'Add as member', 'Follow-up date', 'Not interested' and 'Reopen' cannot be used until the internet is back
must_not: A change shown as saved that never reached the server

steps.action: Tap 'Not interested'
user_sees: A bar at the bottom: '<name>: marked not interested.' with an undo button, for 8 seconds
The row leaves the call-today list
must_not: The enquiry deleted
No way back once the bar is gone

steps.action: Tap undo on the bar
user_sees: The row is back as an open enquiry with its old call-back day
The bar is gone
must_not: A second copy of the enquiry
The call-back day lost

steps.action: Tap 'Not interested' again, wait for the bar to go, open the not-interested list
user_sees: The row with a grey 'Not interested' pill and a 'Reopen' button
A box 'Why did <name> not join? (optional)' showing 'Not known'
must_not: 'Add as member' or 'Follow-up date' still offered on a not-interested row

steps.action: Pick a reason in the box
user_sees: The box shows the reason picked; its first choice now reads 'Clear the reason'
must_not: The reason shown on a different enquiry

steps.action: Tap 'Reopen'
user_sees: The row is an open enquiry again
The reason is cleared
must_not: The old reason kept on a reopened enquiry
The row stuck in the not-interested list after a refresh

start: Enquiries screen, one enquiry a member invited from the member app

steps.action: Open Enquiries and read the invited friend's row
user_sees: 'Referred by <member's name>' on the row
The friend's own name and number
must_not: The inviting member's phone number on the row
Enquiries of another gym or another branch in the list

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp' on the row
user_sees: The ready message opens in the gym person's own WhatsApp, to the friend's number only
must_not: The message sent from a MettleUp number
The friend added to any list they did not ask for
